related_questions.question: What is the IRS three year rule?
related_questions.snippet: You file a claim within 3 years from when you file your return. Your credit or refund is limited to the amount you paid during the 3 years before you filed the claim, plus any extensions of time you had to file your return.

related_questions.question: What is the IRS form 2040 SR?
related_questions.snippet: Key Takeaways. Form 1040-SR is a simplified version of Form 1040 that offers American taxpayers ages 65+ a way to file their taxes, whether or not they itemize deductions. Unlike its predecessor, Form 1040EZ, there are no income limits with Form 1040-SR. Those over 65 are not required to use Form 1040-SR to file.
